content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to know if it's possible to connect [product_name] [article_no] with [product_name] Run Time [version_no]. If so, how can this be done? Thank you for any responses.
If your device is [article_no] FS:04, then integration is not possible. It might be feasible with older versions of [article_no].

From what I know, the [product_name] [article_no] can only communicate with [product_name] [version_no] or [product_name] [version_no]. On this site, there are application examples for [product_name] [version_no] or [product_name] [version_no] but none for [product_name] [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion highlights uncertainty regarding the compatibility between recent [product_name] hardware and specific [product_name] software versions. Responses clarify incompatibility for certain newer hardware (such as [article_no] FS:04) and point out the lack of example projects and documentation for this integration, revealing a gap in available information that affects system planning and user confidence.
